before_first_checkpoint.note: nothing is on disk until the first checkpoint; with buffer_bytes at its 512MB default a writer can accumulate a great deal before one happens

findings.statement: a store killed after at least one checkpoint always opens
findings.detail: 10/10 stores with a completed checkpoint opened; 0 did not.

findings.statement: a store killed before its first checkpoint is readable
findings.detail: 2/2 stores killed before their first checkpoint would not open at all. Everything written so far lives in per-shard memory buffers, and buffer_bytes defaults to 512MB, so this is not a small window

findings.statement: recovery invents nothing: every value read back was actually written
findings.detail: 0 values across 0 trials did not match what the writer wrote

findings.statement: recovery loses only a suffix: at least half the keys survive a mid-run crash
findings.detail: mean 100% of keys present after a crash. Everything since the last checkpoint is buffered in memory, and buffer_bytes defaults to 512MB
